scenes.title: Cloud → contract → code
scenes.accessibleDescription: The approved cloud, contract and code sequence is preserved.

scenes.title: Two loops
scenes.accessibleDescription: Two connected loops: agreement guides delivery; new evidence can send us back.

scenes.title: Start with a brain dump
scenes.accessibleDescription: A useful brain dump can contain frustration, examples and unanswered questions.

scenes.title: Mirror the idea
scenes.accessibleDescription: The mirror makes assumptions visible while they are still easy to correct.

scenes.title: The alignment gate
scenes.accessibleDescription: Agreement is a checkpoint, not a reason to restart settled work.

scenes.title: Research reality
scenes.accessibleDescription: Keep observed behavior separate from planned behavior.

scenes.title: Make decisions visible
scenes.accessibleDescription: Compare decisions that actually change the design.

scenes.title: Architecture → specification
scenes.accessibleDescription: Map responsibilities, then attach observable behavior to each boundary.

scenes.title: Authorize the build
scenes.accessibleDescription: A kickoff connects the agreed plan to permission and a starting point.

scenes.title: Build in small slices
scenes.accessibleDescription: Finish one complete, checkable behavior at a time.

scenes.title: Evidence has levels
scenes.accessibleDescription: Each observation supports a specific claim, not every stronger claim.

scenes.title: Your turn
scenes.accessibleDescription: Carry one small idea through the conversation and into a verifiable build.
